raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Let an external-LB elastic EP scale-up rank be fully prepared before it is needed: it loads the model, allocates its KV cache and captures CUDA graphs without contacting the running ranks, then joins later as any DP rank and into a world of any size, keeping its graphs. A parked rank can be checkpointed with CRIU/cuda-checkpoint (e.g. Dynamo Snapshot) and restored on demand, so one snapshot serves every joining rank.

Depends on three NIXL EP PRs: ai-dynamo/nixl#2533 (defer agent creation), ai-dynamo/nixl#2534 (no FABRIC memory before the transport starts), ai-dynamo/nixl#2535 (rank in device memory, `Buffer.set_rank`). Builds on #62570 (process checkpoint lifecycle) and #43202 (external-LB elastic EP). Related but not overlapping: #62973 standardizes how external ranks are launched, and #62082 correlates scaling operations.

## Claims

- New `VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE` (with `VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH`): the rank builds against placeholder groups, writes `<file>.parked`, and joins once the file names rank 0 (`data_parallel_master_ip`, `data_parallel_rpc_port`) and optionally the DP rank to join as (`data_parallel_rank`).
- A parked rank joins a world of any size up to `--elastic-ep-max-dp-size`, and as any DP rank >= 1, without recapturing CUDA graphs.
- Scale-up drops from ~116-143 s (cold joiner) to ~14 s for DeepSeek-V2-Lite on GB300. With a snapshot restore, the step is ~14-16 s plus the restore.
- Parked ranks act as ordinary ranks in later scale-ups and scale-downs. The rank's API server now learns the DP size and rank 0's address from its engine, which also fixes later scaling of any rank started with a placeholder address.
- Configurations a parked rank cannot join with (rank 0, TP > 1, a backend other than `nixl_ep`, no `--kv-cache-memory-bytes`, the `symm_mem` EPLB communicator, speculative decoding, KV transfer or KV events, fault tolerance) are rejected at startup with a clear error.
- No behavior change unless `VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE` is set.

## Validation

GB300 (4 GPUs/node, MNNVL), DeepSeek-V2-Lite BF16, TP=1, `--all2all-backend nixl_ep --enable-eplb --elastic-ep-max-dp-size 16`, parked ranks with `--data-parallel-size 16 --eplb-config '{"num_redundant_experts":192}' --kv-cache-memory-bytes 8589934592`.

Correctness: 5 prompts x 48 greedy tokens on every rank, one rank at a time, compared with the cold world-4 reference, plus top-3 logprobs for one prompt. (When every rank serves at once, one prompt flips between two continuations whose top-2 logprobs differ by 0.125. A stock cold-joiner control flips at the same rate, so those checks are not used for pass/fail.)

**Current PR head** (the three commits of 52652161f8 applied to main 76c6f3f2a9, the newest nightly, with an identical `vllm/` diff; image `nightly-76c6f3f2` plus this branch's Python files; NIXL at the current heads of ai-dynamo/nixl#2533-#2535). After every scaling step, every rank is checked against the cold world-4 reference:

| Run | 4->8 | 8->4 | outputs (one rank at a time) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Parked as ranks 8-11 in a world of 16 (73 s), snapshot captured in 14.2 s, restored in 8.0 s, joins as 4-7 in a world of 8 | 14.1 s | 11.3 s | world 4: 20/20, world 8: 40/40, back to 4: 20/20. Logprobs identical on all ranks at every step |

**Branch before rebase** (main 70cb50dab2, image `nightly-5d35ce39` plus this branch's Python files, NIXL main + ai-dynamo/nixl#2533-#2535):

| Run | 4->8 | 8->4 | outputs (one rank at a time) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Parked as ranks 8-11 in a world of 16, joins as 4-7 in a world of 8 | 15.2 s | 9.9 s | 80/80, logprobs identical on all ranks |
| Snapshot of that parked pod (capture 16.4 s), restored in 7.3 s, joins as 4-7 in a world of 8 | 14.3 s | 9.6 s | 80/80, logprobs identical on all ranks |

**Earlier, same changes on nightly 8e2beaa3 + NIXL 1.5.0 with the same patches** (3 nodes):

| Run | 4->8 | 8->12 | 12->8 | 8->4 | outputs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stock cold joiners (control) | 143.1 s | 115.7 s | 12.0 s | 9.3 s | 180/180 |
| Parked, ranks moved (8-11 -> 4-7, 4-7 -> 8-11) | 14.7 s | 15.3 s | 12.4 s | 9.7 s | 180/180 |
| Snapshot images captured as 4-7, restored as 4-7 and 8-11 | 13.3 s | 15.5 s | 13.6 s | 10.0 s | 180/180 |
| Same images, slots swapped, direct 4->12->4 | | 16.4 s | | 10.7 s | 100/100 |

Logprobs were bit-identical across all ranks in every world. Snapshot restore of a ~100 GB image (8 GiB KV per GPU) took 7.3-7.7 s.

Unit tests, which run without GPUs or NIXL:
- `tests/distributed/test_detached_group_coordinator.py`: a placeholder group reports its rank and size, fails any collective instead of waiting for peers, and moves to another rank of the same group. Added to the L4 Distributed Comm Ops step.
- `tests/test_config.py`: the startup checks reject unsupported parked configurations and accept a supported one.
- `tests/v1/engine/test_elastic_ep_rank_adoption.py`: a front-end takes the DP rank its parked engine joins as, and only in that case.

`pre-commit` (including mypy) passes. The end-to-end path is not in CI: it needs multiple GPUs, `nixl_ep` with the new NIXL APIs (CI has nixl 1.5.1), and an external join step. Happy to add an elastic EP test once a NIXL release with these APIs is in CI.

## Details

How a parked rank works:
1. `_init_elastic_ep_world` and `initialize_model_parallel` build `DetachedGroupCoordinator` placeholders: no store, process group or communicator. The NIXL EP buffer is allocated with `init_transport=False`, and the EPLB communicator is deferred.
2. The engine captures CUDA graphs with all peers masked, writes `<file>.parked`, and waits for the join file.
3. `join_parked` optionally moves the rank (placeholder world group, `parallel_config`, `Buffer.set_rank`), creates the real groups with the same `create_standby_groups` path old ranks use, runs the MoE/EPLB host-state refresh factored out of `switch_and_prepare` for the world size rank 0 sent, checks M and experts-per-rank against rank 0, connects NIXL EP, then builds the EPLB communicator. The engine then runs the normal scale-up launch steps (weights, expert mapping, reshuffle).

Why graphs stay valid: everything a captured graph reads is sized by M = `elastic_ep_max_dp_size`, experts per rank, logical experts or max tokens (NIXL buffers, EPLB maps, load buffer, batched-expert workspaces) and is updated in place, which is why old ranks already keep their graphs across scale-ups. The only rank baked into graphs was NIXL EP's scalar kernel argument, which ai-dynamo/nixl#2535 moves to device memory.

Limitations: rank 0 cannot be parked. The parked rank must match rank 0's M, experts per rank and `max_num_batched_tokens` (M and experts per rank are checked). Process names keep the launch rank. ~540 added lines outside tests and docs, mostly the parked path and the shared refresh.

+With external load balancing and the `nixl_ep` backend, a scale-up rank can be prepared before it is needed and checkpointed by an external orchestrator. Launch it like any scale-up rank, with `--data-parallel-size` set to `--elastic-ep-max-dp-size`, `num_redundant_experts` in `--eplb-config` chosen so it holds as many experts per rank as the running ranks, `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` set, and `VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE` naming a JSON file. The rank loads the model, allocates its KV cache, captures CUDA graphs without contacting other ranks, and writes `<file>.parked`. Once `/scale_elastic_ep` has been sent to the running ranks, write `{"data_parallel_master_ip": ..., "data_parallel_rpc_port": ..., "data_parallel_rank": ...}` to the file: the rank joins as `data_parallel_rank` (default: its launch rank) in a world of the requested size, keeping its CUDA graphs. Rank 0 cannot be parked.
+
 ## Process Checkpoint APIs
 
 For external checkpoint/restore orchestrators, available with `--enable-sleep-mode`. Preparing drains the engine and releases its KV cache and other external state, any number of times. Until `/checkpoint/restore`, new requests get a retryable error and `/health` still returns 200, as while asleep. `--checkpoint-prepare-on-startup` prepares each engine once it starts.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Placeholder groups of an elastic EP rank that is parked before it joins."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed.stateless_coordinator import DetachedGroupCoordinator
+
+
+def _world(global_rank: int) -> DetachedGroupCoordinator:
+    return DetachedGroupCoordinator(
+        [[0, 1, 2, 3]], local_rank=1, group_name="world", global_rank=global_rank
+    )
+
+
+def test_detached_group_reports_rank_without_peers():
+    group = _world(2)
+    assert (group.rank, group.rank_in_group, group.world_size) == (2, 2, 4)
+    assert (group.cpu_group.rank(), group.cpu_group.size()) == (2, 4)
+
+
+def test_detached_group_collectives_fail_instead_of_waiting():
+    """A collective on a parked rank must fail, not wait for peers that are
+    not there."""
+    group = _world(2)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="peers of a detached group"):
+        group.barrier()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="peers of a detached group"):
+        group.broadcast(torch.zeros(1))
+
+
+def test_detached_group_rebind_moves_rank_within_group():
+    group = _world(1)
+    group.rebind(3)
+    assert (group.rank, group.rank_in_group, group.cpu_group.rank()) == (3, 3, 3)
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="outside the group"):
+        group.rebind(7)

         EngramConfig(use_thp=True, dp_shared_memory=True)
 
 
+def _parked_elastic_ep_config(kv_cache_memory_bytes=1 << 30, **overrides):
+    parallel = ParallelConfig(
+        data_parallel_size=4,
+        data_parallel_rank=1,
+        data_parallel_external_lb=True,
+        all2all_backend="nixl_ep",
+        distributed_executor_backend="mp",
+    )
+    parallel.enable_elastic_ep = True
+    for name, value in overrides.items():
+        setattr(parallel, name, value)
+    return VllmConfig(
+        parallel_config=parallel,
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(kv_cache_memory_bytes=kv_cache_memory_bytes),
+        device_config=DeviceConfig(device="cpu"),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def parked_elastic_ep(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE", "/tmp/join.json")
+
+
+def test_parked_elastic_ep_accepts_supported_config(parked_elastic_ep):
+    _parked_elastic_ep_config()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("overrides", "reason"),
+    [
+        ({"data_parallel_rank": 0}, "DP rank 0 cannot be parked"),
+        ({"all2all_backend": "allgather_reducescatter"}, "all2all-backend nixl_ep"),
+        ({"tensor_parallel_size": 2}, "tensor_parallel_size=1"),
+        ({"enable_fault_tolerance": True}, "fault tolerance"),
+        ({"kv_cache_memory_bytes": None}, "kv-cache-memory-bytes"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_parked_elastic_ep_rejects_unsupported(parked_elastic_ep, overrides, reason):

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""A front-end started for one DP rank adopts the rank its parked elastic EP
+engine joins as."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.v1.engine.utils import (
+    CoreEngine,
+    CoreEngineState,
+    _adopt_parked_engine_rank,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+
+
+def _parallel_config(rank: int) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    return SimpleNamespace(data_parallel_rank=rank, data_parallel_index=rank)
+
+
+def test_parked_engine_rank_is_adopted(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE", "/tmp/join.json")
+    engine = CoreEngine(index=0, local=True)
+    parallel_config = _parallel_config(0)
+
+    adopted = _adopt_parked_engine_rank([engine], 3, parallel_config)
+
+    assert adopted is engine
+    assert engine.identity == (3).to_bytes(2, "little")
+    assert parallel_config.data_parallel_rank == 3
+    assert parallel_config.data_parallel_index == 3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("join_file", "engines", "state"),
+    [
+        # Not a parked joiner.
+        (None, [CoreEngine(0)], CoreEngineState.NEW),
+        # The front-end manages more than one engine.
+        ("/tmp/join.json", [CoreEngine(0), CoreEngine(1)], CoreEngineState.NEW),
+        # The engine is remote.
+        ("/tmp/join.json", [CoreEngine(0, local=False)], CoreEngineState.NEW),
+        # The engine already said hello under its own rank.
+        ("/tmp/join.json", [CoreEngine(0)], CoreEngineState.CONNECTED),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unexpected_rank_is_not_adopted(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    join_file: str | None,
+    engines: list[CoreEngine],
+    state: CoreEngineState,
+):
+    if join_file is None:
+        monkeypatch.delenv("VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE", raising=False)
+    else:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE", join_file)
+    engines[0].state = state
+    parallel_config = _parallel_config(0)
+
+    assert _adopt_parked_engine_rank(engines, 3, parallel_config) is None
+    assert engines[0].identity == (0).to_bytes(2, "little")
+    assert parallel_config.data_parallel_rank == 0

@@ -1277,6 +1277,64 @@ def _verify_direct_reload_compat(self) -> None:
                 "backend. Use VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=layerwise or another backend."
             )
 
+    def _verify_parked_elastic_ep(self) -> None:
+        """Reject configurations that a parked elastic EP rank cannot support."""
+        if not envs.VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_JOIN_FILE:
+            return
+        parallel = self.parallel_config
+        kv_events = self.kv_events_config
+        unsupported = [
+            (
+                not envs.VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH,
+                "it requires VLLM_ELASTIC_EP_SCALE_UP_LAUNCH=1",
+            ),
